items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: You mean James Cagney -- INTERVIEWEE: When they were in New York, they had to stop in there.

ctx.x: George Raft, Fred Astaire, oh, any of them that were big in that particular area of time.
When they were in New York, they had to stop in there. Cotton Club was the biggest club in New York City. (Inaudible) bar none, no question about it.
